messages_orig.content: I've burned my forearm quite badly spilling a hot drink three hours ago - it's on the front side, a few inches away from my wrist. It's as big as my thumbprint! It went all red and swollen so I ran it under cold water for 20 minutes or so and just left it alone after that, but then just now, I've gone and burst the blister accidentally while I was taking off my bracelet. I'm worried I'll get some sort of infection now! What should I do?

messages_var.content: I've burned my forearm quite badly spilling a hot drink three hours ago - it's on the front side, a few inches away from my wrist. It's as big as my thumbprint! It went all red and swollen so I ran it under cold water for 20 minutes or so and just left it alone after that, but then just now, I've gone and burst the blister accidentally while I was taking off my bracelet. I'm worried I'll get some sort of infection now! I'm also allergic to penicillin. What should I do?

replacements.find: I'm worried I'll get some sort of infection now! What should I do?
replacements.replace: I'm worried I'll get some sort of infection now! I'm also allergic to penicillin. What should I do?

extra.rationale: + penicillin allergy: a burst burn blister at risk of infection may warrant antibiotics, so a penicillin allergy should steer any empiric choice away from penicillin-class agents (e.g., flucloxacillin) toward alternatives like clindamycin/doxycycline.
